::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_links"}
#docs
A link with a recurring price is a subscription checkout and needs exactly one plan; a link of one-time prices only is a purchase (a paid invoice, no subscription). Items cannot change after creation: create a new link instead.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | **yes** | The payment link's name. |
| `items` | `array of object` | **yes** | The items the link sells. |
| `items.price` | `string` | **yes** | The price's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro-monthly-usd`). |
| `items.quantity` | `integer` | no | The quantity. Defaults to `1`. |
| `items.min_quantity` | `integer` | no | The buyer may choose a quantity from this value. |
| `items.max_quantity` | `integer` | no | The buyer may choose a quantity up to this value. |
| `items.optional` | `boolean` | no | The buyer may remove this line, or leave it out. |
| `show_on_pricing_page` | `boolean` | no | Whether the link is listed on the pricing page. |
| `redirect_url` | `string` | no | Where to send the customer after they pay. |
| `cancel_url` | `string` | no | Where to send the customer if they cancel. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid body, unknown or archived price, mixed currencies, or no plan |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/payment_links" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Brightwater Analytics",
    "items": [
      {
        "price": "pro-monthly-usd",
        "quantity": 1
      }
    ]
  }'
```
